nativeScenarioNames: new gates are off; old free registration works without any payment/marker issuance
legacy rows remain unbound; duplicate valid issuance reads its original marker without renewing it
ACL/RLS deny client inserts, private reads and cross-member issuance even with an admin metadata claim
prepare is idempotent and snapshots DB price; another intent cannot create a second payment
concurrent claim has one acknowledged winner; attachment is one-time and rejects another authority
all binding fields and issuance markers are immutable; old generic money cannot be attached to a registration
authority lengths 1, 255 and 256 attach on a genuinely claimed intent with gates on
empty, 257, whitespace, newline and nonASCII authorities fail in the RPC and direct table constraint without consuming attachment
settlement gate also blocks the old financial writer; reopening uses the issued amount rather than current price
old consumers cannot revive refunded/free rows or insert paid even with a genuine paid binding and both gates on
paid money survives missing service; deleted registration does not cascade history or permit a fresh issuance
legacy paid metadata is still editable without changing state; original legacy financial/history snapshot is preserved
